name: Bay Books Coffee Shop
notes: Restaurant's own site (baybookscoffee.com) times out on every fetch attempt (router flagged fetch-failed too). Found the full menu via schema.org JSON-LD embedded in the Uber Eats store page (address on page: 1007 Orange Avenue, Coronado, CA 92118, matching batch exactly). Cent-ending distribution (.00/.25/.50/.75/.95) looks like normal in-store pricing, not a uniform delivery markup. Excluded 19 items (Americano, Hot Chocolate, Tea, several Lattes, Smoothies, etc.) that carried a $0.00 base price in the schema - these appear to require a required size/flavor modifier whose real price isn't captured by the Menu schema, so filing a $0 price would be misleading. Also excluded a 'FIFA' section (stickers, sticker album, hat) as non-food retail merchandise.
